text:
emily: Idea  a short after-hours "Micro Thanks" pop-up next Thursday 6:00pm PT in the lobby for quick, in-the-moment peer shoutouts. 30 mins, casual — sticky notes + tiny swag. Low effort, high visibility. Whos in to help run?

marco: love this. can help run a station for 6-6:30pm. happy to do sticky-note moderation (collect & digitize).

priya: i can design a one-sheet with 3 example prompts (impact, teammate behavior, short outcome) and a small poster. will post a draft here tomorrow.

josh: i'll handle the mini-swag pack (stickers + enamel pin sample). estimate $120 for 50 packs. ok to proceed?

finance-bot: FYI: small recognition swag under $5 per item is fine; confirm project code REC-EVENING and submit receipts. PO required if vendor > $500.

arman: i'll staff the remote stream + quick phone-photo uploads so remote folks can join. can we put a Zoom link on the poster?

emily: yes include Zoom. capacity is informal; plan to collect notes and funnel them into the monthly highlight reel. also want a quick consent checkbox for public sharing. priya, could you add that to the poster copy?

priya: yep will add: "I consent to sharing this highlight internally (checkbox)." also adding a QR code to the quick nomination form for folks who prefer to type.

marco: logistics: need a volunteer to pick up 50 small food boxes at 5:30pm (budget $150). can anyone do pickup and receipt?

josh: i can do pickup if its within walking distance. will put on card and hand receipts to finance.

finance-bot: Reminder: per-event catering limit for ad-hoc pop-ups is $200. Please tag receipts with REC-EVENING.

ops-bot: poster template uploaded: /assets/recog/posters/micro-thanks-poster.png

emily: perfect. timeline: poster + Zoom up Wed EOD, swag & food ordered Wed morning, pickup Thu 5:30pm, event 6pm. can all volunteers confirm?

marco: confirmed for moderation and digitizing notes.

priya: confirmed for visuals + QR. posting draft in 2 hours.

josh: confirmed for swag + food pickup.

arman: confirmed for streaming and photo uploads. will also export a short clip for socials if approved.

emily: quick Q: should we include a brief 2-line note about spot award eligibility so people don't assume every shoutout equals an award?

marco: yes please. add: "Shoutouts feed the monthly highlight reel. Spot awards follow separate review and eligibility rules."

priya: added that to the poster draft.

finance-bot: Note: spot awards are subject to payroll deadlines and tax rules; shoutouts are informal and non-monetary unless nominated through the form and approved.

emily: awesome. last item: if anyone wants to demo how to convert a shoutout into a formal nomination, we'll do a 5min live demo at 6:10pm. volunteer to demo?

josh: i'll demo with one live example. short before/after phrasing.

emily: thank you everyone  i'll post the final poster + calendar invite tomorrow morning. excited to try a low-friction recognition touchpoint! :sparkles:
